name: p74-authentication-credential-policy-boundary
title: P7.4 認證憑證策略安全邊界
description: Document and enforce the security boundary between legacy account-password authentication and the non-secret, disabled local typed contact-read boundary; no runtime authentication migration, CE, traffic, P7.5 or P8 action.
scope: Task/documentation-only credential-policy decision. No C# or runtime configuration change, CE request/mutation, feature enablement, traffic switch, P7.5 removal, P8 deployment, push or PR.
creator: codex
notes: Legacy account/password login reads new_app_pass and compares plaintext. The completed typed contact-read boundary contains no secret and must not be used to verify credentials or rehydrate a CRM Entity. A future auth.contact.credential.verify capability needs an approved secret-safe source model and independent authorization/session/isolation/lifecycle design. Gemini partial output recommended an unsafe LINE DTO-to-Entity rehydration and was rejected; Claude quota/session blocked. Record is 雙模型未完成, not a completed dual-model review.
